name: Borderborn
text:
Whether by design or random chance, you were born in a place where the Universe and First World intersect. Born of two places, yet fully part of neither, all your life you've felt as if you had to balance on a tightrope between the mundane and the mysterious. You have an instinctive grasp of how to find thin places where it's possible to cross over to the First World. Yet, you avoid them and sometimes even stand guard against them, afraid that once you cross over, you'll never want to come back.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Occultism skill and the First World Lore skill. You gain the Widdershins Thrice ability.
